# pai harness

Sessions PAI can read from agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, ...)

```
pai harness <command>
```

Read-only ingestion of other harnesses' session logs. `list` shows each adapter: detected (its store exists), enabled (config key harness.adapters), and its session count. `sessions` lists the sessions themselves.

```sh
pai harness list
pai harness sessions
pai harness sessions --harness codex --cwd ~/proj
```

See also: `pai config get harness.adapters`

### pai harness list

Each adapter: detected, enabled, session count

```
pai harness list [options]
```

One row per adapter PAI knows. Only enabled adapters whose store exists are ever read.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai harness list
pai harness list --json
```

### pai harness sessions

List sessions, newest first

```
pai harness sessions [options]
```

Sessions of the enabled adapters (or one harness with --harness), optionally limited to one working directory.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--harness NAME` | string | — | Only this adapter (default: the enabled set) |
| `--cwd DIR` | string | — | Only sessions of this working directory |
| `--json` | flag | — | Print JSON instead of a table |

```sh
pai harness sessions
pai harness sessions --harness codex
pai harness sessions --cwd ~/proj
```

### pai harness setup

Make a harness a PAI frontend (opencode)

```
pai harness setup HARNESS [options]
```

Writes the OpenCode config that registers PAI's MCP server (as Claude Code has it), points OpenCode at PAI's instructions (rendered for OpenCode from the one source), exposes your Claude Code commands, and installs the bridge plugin that applies PAI's delegation and security guards. Dry run unless --write; changed files are backed up first. Never touches opencode.jsonc.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `HARNESS` | yes | opencode |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--write` | flag | — | Apply the plan (default: show it) |
| `--config-dir DIR` | string | — | OpenCode config dir (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode or ~/.config/opencode) |
| `--all-mcp` | flag | — | Register every Claude Code MCP server, not only pai |
| `--provider NAME` | string | — | Run OpenCode's own model through the PAI router on this provider |
| `--model MODEL` | string | — | Model for --provider |

```sh
pai harness setup opencode
pai harness setup opencode --write
pai harness setup opencode --write --provider glm --model glm-5
```

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai harness list` | Each adapter: detected, enabled, session count |
